coat.method: individual skinned short fibres, limited alpha-cutout edge tufts and tiled fibre normal detail on UV1
coat.bodyShape: shallow individual rib arcs, scapular hollow and pelvic crest
coat.pigment: charcoal gray-brown, warm worn rib peaks, pale underside and muzzle, subdued upper eyelid
coat.detailNormalUv: FurDetailUV; author-scaled short-coat flow, 0.22 m per texture repeat
coat.shadow: groomCastShadow=false; body and accessories cast shadows, micro-fibre layer receives them

motion: Advance the root along local -Z. Walk time = distance / 0.68 * 1.2 seconds; Idle uses an independent 3-second clock.

derivation.scope: animal body, eyes, ears, mane, tail and short fur only; no cart, shafts, collar, straps, halter or lead rope

appearance.source: user original donkey three-view; cart side image used only for animal identity
appearance.animation: re-solve both clips against refined joint heights; original stride and duration retained
appearance.material: neutral gray-brown short coat, fine directional fibres, pale belly and muzzle
appearance.shape: more upright neck/poll, extended muzzle, rounded abdomen, locally smoothed shoulder/hamstring, fuller short mane and narrower ear splay

derivation.skeleton: 28 bone names and hierarchy retained; carpus/hock lowered by 9 cm, both actions re-solved. Unused DonkeyHitchPivot retained for compatibility.

verification.sourceAnatomyEvidence: V2 bone layout and hoof surfaces retained. Selected torso edges are subdivided for rib/scapula form; inserted weights are interpolated and normalized to four influences. Both clips and the packed GLB are independently sampled.
